Title: Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Azure Data Factory service principal authentication

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce that you can now use service principal Entra authentication to connect your Azure Database for PostgreSQL instance with Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure Data Factory. This feature enhances security and simplifies the authentication process. 

Learn more.
